requests.question: What happened to Magistrate Vell after the flood?
requests.answer: After the flood, Magistrate Ondrej Vell faked his own death and survived by hiding beneath the city, living off supplies smuggled down by a loyal harbor guard. He remained hidden for eleven years, surviving in the very place no one had thought to search for him.
